statements.status_notes: The image ships @octokit/endpoint 9.0.6, the patched release of the 9.x line for GHSA-x4c5-c7rf-jjgv (vulnerable ranges >=9.0.5 <9.0.6 and >=10.0.0 <10.1.3), so the backtracking regular expression in endpoint.parse is not present. Scanners that compare 9.0.6 against the 10.1.3 fix of the 10.x line report a false positive.

The image ships @octokit/endpoint 9.0.6, the patched release of the 9.x line for GHSA-x4c5-c7rf-jjgv (vulnerable ranges >=9.0.5 <9.0.6 and >=10.0.0 <10.1.3), so the backtracking regular expression in endpoint.parse is not present. Scanners that compare 9.0.6 against the 10.1.3 fix of the 10.x line report a false positive.

The build ships @octokit/endpoint 10.1.3, which is the fixed release for the 10.x line, so the vulnerable route/preview parsing regexes are not present (GHSA-x4c5-c7rf-jjgv: >=9.0.5 <9.0.6 and >=10.0.0 <10.1.3).
